g.text: Study A | Where allocation time was spent at the 60-second search allowance
Each bar is one saved execution, not an average. O = validated optimal; F = validated feasible; C = construction failure. Native presolve is inside the search
call; these measurements do not isolate a SCIP startup phase. No service/network timing is included.
